Sekiro sword combat after the tutorial

Game: Sekiro. This is a synthetic wrong-game validation fixture.

In Sekiro, the protagonist fights with the Kusabimaru sword. This guide describes sword combat and posture attacks after the tutorial. Learn parries and deflections against Ashina soldiers before advancing. Use the grappling hook to reach rooftops, and practice sword timing before fighting the next enemy.

This source covers Sekiro sword combat. It does not describe an Elden Ring Samurai, Uchigatana upgrade path, Dexterity build, Smithing Stones, or Limgrave progression.
